title: Tactics backup
headline: The proposed FY2027 ceilings total ฿2,760 million over 11 lines, 5.2% of FY2025 revenue, a team proposal and not CPN guidance.

columns.title: [Proposed] FY2027 ceilings (THB million)
rows: Great Chinese New Year with Central Retail
Gen Z content, fandom, creator and Pride programme
Opening launches: The Orchard, The Central Phaholyothin, CenTRal cENtrAL
Tourist programme for India, Gulf and Europe
CENTRAL X and The 1 O2O incentives

columns.title: [Proposed] Release rules (Section 6.1)
columns.text: Lines 4, 6 and 7 (฿310 million) are released in two halves: ฿155 million at G0, ฿105 million (lines 4 and 7) at G1, and ฿50 million (line 6) at G2 if the registrant data support it. Line 5 (฿250 million) is released opening by opening, after CPN confirms the date.

columns.title: Channels (Sections 4.3 and 4.4)
items: CPN's own: Central Life X app, LINE account Central Life, CENTRAL X (Scan Receipt at 44 centres).
CPN Serve is a tenant app; whether CENTRAL X replaced Central Life X is not established.
[Proposed] CENTRAL X as the single app front door (D4), with Gen Z missions added (P7).
The 1 Tourist counters at 14 centres; free welcome package, discounts up to 40%, which CPN may change.
[Proposed] Gen Z media weighted to TikTok, YouTube and LINE; creator briefs tied to CENTRAL X registration.
[Proposed] Tourist partners and a TAT Diwali event: Gulf from Q2, Europe from Q3, India from Q4 (D3, R5).
[Proposed] Pilot enrolling Malaysian shoppers at Central i-City into The 1 Tourist in Q2 (D5).

columns.title: [Proposed] FY2027 campaign calendar
rows: Great Chinese New Year with Central Retail
30 Jan–1 Mar 2026; ฿600 million, joint with Central Retail
Summer Fest 2027 with Songkran as a module; Gen Z stages
Pride For All with a disclosed creator network
LEAD Year 9 sandbox; State Your Style successor; first milestone report
LEAD sandbox 20–26 Jul; State Your Style 3 Sep–4 Oct 2026
India programme with TAT; China Golden Week campaign
Diwali and Golden Week campaign announced for Oct 2025
Year-end season with Countdown on 31 December 2027
Magical Stars over ฿800 million (as reported); Countdown 2026 over ฿500 million
Opening campaigns for three FY2027 openings; always-on creator content

notes: Backup slide, not presented. Budget lines 1 to 11 are ceilings set against disclosed comparators; lines 1 to 3 sum to 1,900 and lines 4 to 11 to 860. The release rules are in Section 6.1. Plan-team time is not in these 11 lines; we assume it sits in existing SG&A (team assumption, not costed).
